---
title: "Formats"
---

The extension contributes four Quarto formats. Each one is selected
by name in the `format:` key of a `.qmd` frontmatter or a project
`_quarto.yml`. All four formats share the same palette tokens, font
stacks, and syntax-highlighting mapping — switching formats does not
mean re-learning the visual language.

## `pequod-revealjs` — slide decks (light)

```yaml
---
title: "Your title"
format: pequod-revealjs
---
```

Defaults that ship: 1600 × 900 surface, `center: true` (slides
vertically centred by reveal), `slide-number: c/t`, Atkinson
Hyperlegible Next body, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono code. Per-slide
opt-outs:

```markdown
## A photo wall {.no-footer .no-logo}
```

The deck title slide and H1 section dividers already have the footer
and logo hidden by convention.

## `pequod-dark-revealjs` — slide decks (dark)

```yaml
format: pequod-dark-revealjs
```

Same shape as the light variant, deep-ink ground, paper-tone text,
dark crew accents.

## `pequod-html` — documents (light + dark)

```yaml
format:
  pequod-html:
    theme-toggle: true   # surfaces the navbar light/dark control
```

What's wired by default:

- `theme: { light: pequod-html.scss, dark: pequod-html-dark.scss }`
- `highlight-style: { light: pequod.theme, dark: pequod-dark.theme }`
- `code-copy: true`, `code-overflow: wrap`
- `smooth-scroll: true`, `anchor-sections: true`
- `link-external-newwindow: true` (external links open new tab)
- `fig-cap-location: bottom`, `tbl-cap-location: top`

Print stylesheet built in: hides navbar / sidebar / TOC / footer,
prints `(href)` after external links, strips surface fills, prevents
page breaks inside headings / figures / tables.

## `pequod-typst` — PDF output

```yaml
format: pequod-typst
```

What's wired by default:

- A4 paper, 2.5 cm margins
- `mainfont: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next"`,
  `monofont: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"`,
  `codefont: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"` (Quarto's Typst template
  reads `codefont`, not `monofont`, for `show raw`)
- `font-paths: [fonts]` relative to the extension dir so the
  bundled static-weight TTFs load under the org-prefixed install
- `pequod-typst.typ` include that overrides Quarto's default
  `#callout(...)` to remap Bootstrap colours to the crew

Crew → callout colour mapping (identical across HTML / reveal / Typst):

| Callout | Crew | Hue |
|---|---|---|
| `note` | Starbuck | blue |
| `tip` | Tashtego | green |
| `warning` | Stubb | orange |
| `caution` | Pip | warm dark yellow |
| `important` | Ahab (danger) | red |
